author: More Perfect Union
description:
We spoke to the nurses fighting to purge Palantir from one of the largest hospital chains in the country.

The surveillance company makes billions in contracts with ICE and the U.S. military. Now it’s expanding into the big business of health care — extending its influence to roughly 1 out of every 5 hospital beds in America.

HCA nurses warn its AI algorithms are making staff shortages worse, maximizing corporate profits while patient care suffers.

Producer: @janus.rose
Editor: Joseph Howard
Videographer: Sam Rosenthal
Supervising Producer: Court Fuller
title: Palantir is taking over hospitals — and nurses are PISSED
